# Setup

Upload the `data/training/` folder to your Google Drive first.
Run `R/10_export_training_data.R` locally to generate it.

```{r setup}
# Install packages if needed (run once on Colab)
if (!requireNamespace("torch", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("torch")
  torch::install_torch(type = "gpu")
}
if (!requireNamespace("tidyverse", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyverse")
if (!requireNamespace("luz", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("luz")
if (!requireNamespace("coro", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("coro")

library(torch)
library(luz)
library(tidyverse)
library(coro)

device <- if (cuda_is_available()) "cuda" else "cpu"
cat("Device:", device, "\n")
if (device == "cuda") cat("GPU:", cuda_get_device_name(0), "\n")
```

```{r config}
# === CONFIGURATION ===
# Change DATA_DIR to your Google Drive mount path
DATA_DIR <- "/content/drive/MyDrive/R_project/data/training"
# Or if running locally:
# DATA_DIR <- "C:/Users/mail2/OneDrive/Desktop/R project 1/data/training"

MODEL_SAVE_PATH <- file.path(dirname(DATA_DIR), "models", "unet_3d_trained.pt")
dir.create(dirname(MODEL_SAVE_PATH), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

BATCH_SIZE <- 2L    # Increase to 4 if GPU has 16GB+ VRAM
EPOCHS <- 50L
LEARNING_RATE <- 1e-4
N_CLASSES <- 4L     # background, necrosis, edema, enhancing
IN_CHANNELS <- 4L   # T1, T1c, T2, FLAIR
BASE_FILTERS <- 16L
TRAIN_SPLIT <- 0.8
```

# Load Data

```{r load_manifest}
manifest <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "manifest.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Total samples:", nrow(manifest), "\n")
cat("Patients:", n_distinct(manifest$patient_id), "\n")

# Filter out samples with no tumor
manifest <- manifest %>% filter(tumor_voxels > 0)
cat("Samples with tumor:", nrow(manifest), "\n")

# Show label distribution
manifest %>%
  count(seg_labels) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print()
```

```{r train_val_split}
set.seed(42)
patient_ids <- unique(manifest$patient_id)
n_train <- floor(length(patient_ids) * TRAIN_SPLIT)
train_patients <- sample(patient_ids, n_train)
val_patients <- setdiff(patient_ids, train_patients)

train_manifest <- manifest %>% filter(patient_id %in% train_patients)
val_manifest <- manifest %>% filter(patient_id %in% val_patients)

cat("Train:", nrow(train_manifest), "samples from", length(train_patients), "patients\n")
cat("Val:  ", nrow(val_manifest), "samples from", length(val_patients), "patients\n")
```

# Dataset & DataLoader

```{r dataset}
tumor_dataset <- dataset(
  "TumorDataset",
  initialize = function(manifest_df, data_dir, augment = FALSE) {
    self$manifest <- manifest_df
    self$data_dir <- data_dir
    self$augment <- augment
  },
  .getitem = function(i) {
    row <- self$manifest[i, ]
    mri <- torch_load(file.path(self$data_dir, row$mri_file))$to(dtype = torch_float())
    seg <- torch_load(file.path(self$data_dir, row$seg_file))$to(dtype = torch_long())

    # Random augmentation during training
    if (self$augment) {
      # Random flip along each axis
      if (runif(1) > 0.5) {
        mri <- torch_flip(mri, 2)  # flip X
        seg <- torch_flip(seg, 1)
      }
      if (runif(1) > 0.5) {
        mri <- torch_flip(mri, 3)  # flip Y
        seg <- torch_flip(seg, 2)
      }
      # Random intensity scaling
      scale <- 0.9 + runif(1) * 0.2  # 0.9 to 1.1
      mri <- mri * scale
    }

    list(x = mri, y = seg)
  },
  .length = function() {
    nrow(self$manifest)
  }
)

train_ds <- tumor_dataset(train_manifest, DATA_DIR, augment = TRUE)
val_ds <- tumor_dataset(val_manifest, DATA_DIR, augment = FALSE)

train_dl <- dataloader(train_ds, batch_size = BATCH_SIZE, shuffle = TRUE,
                        num_workers = 0)
val_dl <- dataloader(val_ds, batch_size = BATCH_SIZE, shuffle = FALSE,
                      num_workers = 0)

# Verify data loading
batch <- train_dl$.iter()$.next()
cat("MRI batch shape:", paste(dim(batch$x), collapse = "x"), "\n")
cat("Seg batch shape:", paste(dim(batch$y), collapse = "x"), "\n")
cat("MRI range:", round(batch$x$min()$item(), 2), "to", round(batch$x$max()$item(), 2), "\n")
cat("Seg labels:", paste(sort(unique(as.integer(batch$y$cpu()))), collapse = ","), "\n")
```

# 3D U-Net Model

```{r model_definition}
conv_block_3d <- nn_module(
  "ConvBlock3D",
  initialize = function(in_ch, out_ch) {
    self$conv1 <- nn_conv3d(in_ch, out_ch, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$bn1   <- nn_batch_norm3d(out_ch)
    self$conv2 <- nn_conv3d(out_ch, out_ch, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$bn2   <- nn_batch_norm3d(out_ch)
    self$relu  <- nn_relu()
  },
  forward = function(x) {
    x <- self$relu(self$bn1(self$conv1(x)))
    x <- self$relu(self$bn2(self$conv2(x)))
    x
  }
)

encoder_block_3d <- nn_module(
  "EncoderBlock3D",
  initialize = function(in_ch, out_ch) {
    self$conv_block <- conv_block_3d(in_ch, out_ch)
    self$pool <- nn_max_pool3d(kernel_size = 2, stride = 2)
  },
  forward = function(x) {
    features <- self$conv_block(x)
    pooled <- self$pool(features)
    list(features = features, pooled = pooled)
  }
)

decoder_block_3d <- nn_module(
  "DecoderBlock3D",
  initialize = function(in_ch, out_ch) {
    self$upconv <- nn_conv_transpose3d(in_ch, out_ch, kernel_size = 2, stride = 2)
    self$conv_block <- conv_block_3d(out_ch * 2, out_ch)
  },
  forward = function(x, skip) {
    x <- self$upconv(x)
    diff_d <- skip$size(3) - x$size(3)
    diff_h <- skip$size(4) - x$size(4)
    diff_w <- skip$size(5) - x$size(5)
    x <- nnf_pad(x, c(
      diff_w %/% 2, diff_w - diff_w %/% 2,
      diff_h %/% 2, diff_h - diff_h %/% 2,
      diff_d %/% 2, diff_d - diff_d %/% 2
    ))
    x <- torch_cat(list(x, skip), dim = 2)
    self$conv_block(x)
  }
)

unet_3d <- nn_module(
  "UNet3D",
  initialize = function(in_channels = 4L, n_classes = 4L, base_filters = 16L) {
    f <- base_filters
    self$enc1 <- encoder_block_3d(in_channels, f)
    self$enc2 <- encoder_block_3d(f, f * 2L)
    self$enc3 <- encoder_block_3d(f * 2L, f * 4L)
    self$enc4 <- encoder_block_3d(f * 4L, f * 8L)
    self$bottleneck <- conv_block_3d(f * 8L, f * 16L)
    self$dec4 <- decoder_block_3d(f * 16L, f * 8L)
    self$dec3 <- decoder_block_3d(f * 8L, f * 4L)
    self$dec2 <- decoder_block_3d(f * 4L, f * 2L)
    self$dec1 <- decoder_block_3d(f * 2L, f)
    self$final_conv <- nn_conv3d(f, n_classes, kernel_size = 1)
  },
  forward = function(x) {
    e1 <- self$enc1(x);  e2 <- self$enc2(e1$pooled)
    e3 <- self$enc3(e2$pooled); e4 <- self$enc4(e3$pooled)
    b <- self$bottleneck(e4$pooled)
    d4 <- self$dec4(b, e4$features); d3 <- self$dec3(d4, e3$features)
    d2 <- self$dec2(d3, e2$features); d1 <- self$dec1(d2, e1$features)
    self$final_conv(d1)
  }
)

model <- unet_3d(IN_CHANNELS, N_CLASSES, BASE_FILTERS)
model <- model$to(device = device)
n_params <- sum(sapply(model$parameters, function(p) prod(p$shape)))
cat("3D U-Net parameters:", format(n_params, big.mark = ","), "\n")
```

# Loss Functions

```{r loss}
dice_loss <- function(pred, target, smooth = 1.0) {
  pred_soft <- nnf_softmax(pred, dim = 2)
  n_classes <- pred$size(2)
  total_loss <- torch_tensor(0, device = pred$device)

  for (c in seq_len(n_classes)) {
    pred_c <- pred_soft[, c, , , ]
    target_c <- (target == (c - 1L))$to(dtype = torch_float())
    intersection <- (pred_c * target_c)$sum()
    union_val <- pred_c$sum() + target_c$sum()
    dice <- (2 * intersection + smooth) / (union_val + smooth)
    total_loss <- total_loss + (1 - dice)
  }

  total_loss / n_classes
}

combined_loss <- function(pred, target) {
  ce <- nnf_cross_entropy(pred, target$to(dtype = torch_long()))
  dl <- dice_loss(pred, target)
  0.5 * ce + 0.5 * dl
}
```

# Training Loop

```{r training}
optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = LEARNING_RATE, weight_decay = 1e-5)
scheduler <- lr_step(optimizer, step_size = 20L, gamma = 0.5)

best_val_loss <- Inf
best_val_dice <- 0
history <- list(train_loss = c(), val_loss = c(), val_dice = c())
patience_counter <- 0
patience <- 10

compute_dice_score <- function(pred, target, n_classes = 4L) {
  pred_class <- pred$argmax(dim = 2)
  scores <- c()
  for (c in 2:n_classes) {  # Skip background (class 0)
    pred_c <- (pred_class == (c - 1L))$to(dtype = torch_float())
    target_c <- (target == (c - 1L))$to(dtype = torch_float())
    intersection <- (pred_c * target_c)$sum()$item()
    union_val <- pred_c$sum()$item() + target_c$sum()$item()
    dice <- if (union_val > 0) 2 * intersection / union_val else 1.0
    scores <- c(scores, dice)
  }
  mean(scores)
}

cat("\nStarting training...\n\n")

for (epoch in seq_len(EPOCHS)) {
  # Train
  model$train()
  train_losses <- c()

  coro::loop(for (batch in train_dl) {
    x <- batch$x$to(device = device)
    y <- batch$y$to(device = device)

    optimizer$zero_grad()
    pred <- model(x)
    loss <- combined_loss(pred, y)
    loss$backward()
    nn_utils_clip_grad_norm_(model$parameters, max_norm = 1.0)
    optimizer$step()

    train_losses <- c(train_losses, loss$item())
  })

  avg_train_loss <- mean(train_losses)

  # Validate
  model$eval()
  val_losses <- c()
  val_dices <- c()

  with_no_grad({
    coro::loop(for (batch in val_dl) {
      x <- batch$x$to(device = device)
      y <- batch$y$to(device = device)
      pred <- model(x)
      loss <- combined_loss(pred, y)
      val_losses <- c(val_losses, loss$item())
      val_dices <- c(val_dices, compute_dice_score(pred, y, N_CLASSES))
    })
  })

  avg_val_loss <- mean(val_losses)
  avg_val_dice <- mean(val_dices)
  scheduler$step()

  history$train_loss <- c(history$train_loss, avg_train_loss)
  history$val_loss <- c(history$val_loss, avg_val_loss)
  history$val_dice <- c(history$val_dice, avg_val_dice)

  msg <- sprintf("Epoch %02d/%d | Train Loss: %.4f | Val Loss: %.4f | Val Dice: %.4f",
                 epoch, EPOCHS, avg_train_loss, avg_val_loss, avg_val_dice)

  if (avg_val_dice > best_val_dice) {
    best_val_dice <- avg_val_dice
    best_val_loss <- avg_val_loss
    torch_save(model, MODEL_SAVE_PATH)
    msg <- paste0(msg, " *BEST*")
    patience_counter <- 0
  } else {
    patience_counter <- patience_counter + 1
  }

  cat(msg, "\n")

  if (patience_counter >= patience) {
    cat("Early stopping at epoch", epoch, "\n")
    break
  }
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Training Complete\n")
cat("Best Val Dice:", round(best_val_dice, 4), "\n")
cat("Best Val Loss:", round(best_val_loss, 4), "\n")
cat("Model saved:", MODEL_SAVE_PATH, "\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```

# Training Curves

```{r training_curves, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
library(patchwork)

p1 <- tibble(
  epoch = seq_along(history$train_loss),
  Train = history$train_loss,
  Val = history$val_loss
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-epoch, names_to = "Split", values_to = "Loss") %>%
  ggplot(aes(epoch, Loss, color = Split)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Training & Validation Loss") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Train = "#2563eb", Val = "#dc2626")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p2 <- tibble(epoch = seq_along(history$val_dice), Dice = history$val_dice) %>%
  ggplot(aes(epoch, Dice)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#059669") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = best_val_dice, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = paste("Validation Dice Score (Best:", round(best_val_dice, 4), ")")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(title = "3D U-Net Training on LUMIERE Dataset")
```

# Evaluate on Validation Set

```{r evaluation}
model <- torch_load(MODEL_SAVE_PATH)
model <- model$to(device = device)
model$eval()

class_names <- c("Necrosis", "Edema", "Enhancing")
per_class_dice <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(val_manifest), ncol = 3)

with_no_grad({
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(val_manifest))) {
    row <- val_manifest[i, ]
    mri <- torch_load(file.path(DATA_DIR, row$mri_file))$unsqueeze(1)$to(device = device)
    seg <- torch_load(file.path(DATA_DIR, row$seg_file))$unsqueeze(1)$to(device = device)

    pred <- model(mri)
    pred_class <- pred$argmax(dim = 2)

    for (c in 1:3) {
      pred_c <- (pred_class == c)$to(dtype = torch_float())
      target_c <- (seg == c)$to(dtype = torch_float())
      intersection <- (pred_c * target_c)$sum()$item()
      union_val <- pred_c$sum()$item() + target_c$sum()$item()
      per_class_dice[i, c] <- if (union_val > 0) 2 * intersection / union_val else NA
    }
  }
})

cat("\nPer-Class Dice Scores (Validation Set):\n")
for (c in 1:3) {
  scores <- per_class_dice[, c]
  scores <- scores[!is.na(scores)]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %.4f +/- %.4f (n=%d)\n",
              class_names[c], mean(scores), sd(scores), length(scores)))
}
cat(sprintf("  Overall: %.4f\n", mean(per_class_dice, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

# Visual Results

```{r visual_results, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Show predictions for first 4 validation samples
n_show <- min(4, nrow(val_manifest))
plots <- list()

with_no_grad({
  for (i in seq_len(n_show)) {
    row <- val_manifest[i, ]
    mri <- torch_load(file.path(DATA_DIR, row$mri_file))$unsqueeze(1)$to(device = device)
    seg_gt <- torch_load(file.path(DATA_DIR, row$seg_file))

    pred <- model(mri)
    seg_pred <- as.array(pred$argmax(dim = 2)$squeeze(1)$cpu())
    seg_gt <- as.array(seg_gt)

    z <- dim(seg_gt)[3] %/% 2

    df_gt <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(dim(seg_gt)[1]), y = seq_len(dim(seg_gt)[2]))
    df_gt$label <- factor(as.vector(seg_gt[, , z]))
    df_pred <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(dim(seg_pred)[1]), y = seq_len(dim(seg_pred)[2]))
    df_pred$label <- factor(as.vector(seg_pred[, , z]))

    seg_colors <- c("0" = "black", "1" = "#e74c3c", "2" = "#f39c12", "3" = "#2ecc71")

    p_gt <- ggplot(df_gt, aes(x, y, fill = label)) +
      geom_raster() + scale_fill_manual(values = seg_colors, guide = "none") +
      coord_fixed() + labs(title = paste(row$patient_id, "- Ground Truth")) +
      theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))

    p_pr <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(x, y, fill = label)) +
      geom_raster() + scale_fill_manual(values = seg_colors, guide = "none") +
      coord_fixed() + labs(title = "Prediction") +
      theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))

    plots <- c(plots, list(p_gt, p_pr))
  }
})

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4) +
  plot_annotation(title = "3D U-Net Segmentation: Ground Truth vs Prediction")
```

# Save Final Results

```{r save}
results <- tibble(
  metric = c("Best Val Dice", "Best Val Loss",
             paste("Dice -", class_names),
             "Overall Dice", "Epochs Trained", "Parameters"),
  value = c(
    round(best_val_dice, 4),
    round(best_val_loss, 4),
    round(colMeans(per_class_dice, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    round(mean(per_class_dice, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    length(history$train_loss),
    format(n_params, big.mark = ",")
  )
)

print(results)
write_csv(results, file.path(dirname(MODEL_SAVE_PATH), "unet_results.csv"))

cat("\nDone. Download the trained model from:", MODEL_SAVE_PATH, "\n")
cat("Place it in your local project: models/unet_3d_trained.pt\n")
```
